mira_sales: flagging Atlas Health POC. exec demo tomorrow. demo app showing slow first-byte ~2s and sporadic 429s. can we triage quickly? :eyes:
diego_se: on it. hosted or private? any sample logs or request ids?
atlas_client: hosted. reproducible on new sessions only. sample trace: ```
2026-03-21T07:40:12Z req=at-900 model=redwood-13b status=200 ftb_ms=2012
2026-03-21T07:40:13Z req=at-901 model=redwood-13b status=429 error=rate_limit_exceeded
2026-03-21T07:40:14Z req=at-902 model=redwood-13b status=200 ftb_ms=1987
```
eli_oncall: initial read: high cold-cache miss + per-org concurrency cap. infra shows warmup disabled for org=atlas, cache_miss_rate=81%, concurrency_limit=28. 429 spikes align with short retry bursts.
diego_se: client behavior? new connection per request, large context send, aggressive retries?
atlas_client: yep, they open new session for each user action and include full transcript each time. retries set to 3 with short backoff.
eli_oncall: recommended immediate mitigations: 1) enable transient warm pool for demo (1 GPU) 2) bump per-org concurrency 28->75 for demo window 3) ask client to run a tiny warmup and enable connection reuse/keep-alive 4) advise prefix seeding on session start
mira_sales: they need a cost number to sign off. Diego, can you give an estimate for the demo uplift?
diego_se: rough estimate: 1xA100 warm pool for 2 hours =~ $80 infra uplift. token costs minimal. if sustained, recommend dedicated reserved commit.
jm_security: security note: they asked about KMS integration and audit logs. hosted KMS binding requires signed DPA addendum + customer key (AWS/GCP/Azure) and ~3-5 business days for binding/audit config. we can share SOC2 artifacts.
atlas_client: can you flip warm pool now? demo at 10:30 PT tomorrow.
eli_oncall: scheduled warm pool and concurrency override for 2026-03-21T09:45:00-07:00 -> 2026-03-21T12:00:00-07:00. monitoring enabled.
atlas_client: any warmup snippet?
diego_se: small warmup script to seed prefix cache: ```bash
for i in 1 2 3; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-13b","input":"warmup"}' &
done
wait
```
eli_oncall: post-warmup smoke: FTb samples 140ms, 190ms, 160ms; no 429 in 15m. cache_miss_rate dropped to ~10%.
atlas_client: confirmed, demo perf looks stable now. thanks all.
mira_sales: next steps: 1) send $80 uplift estimate + KMS checklist to Atlas finance 2) recommend dedicated reserved plan for sustained needs 3) schedule 30m retro after demo. Diego/Eli/JM can you join?
diego_se: yes
eli_oncall: yes
jm_security: yes
mira_sales: closing thread. documented as "cold-cache + concurrency cap; mitigated with warm pool + client warmup" :white_check_mark:
